name: ETH3D: High-Resolution Multi-View Stereo and Visual SLAM Benchmark
description: ETH3D is a benchmark for high-resolution multi-view stereo, 3D reconstruction, and visual SLAM. Captured using calibrated DSLR cameras and high-precision survey-grade laser scanners across 43 indoor and outdoor scenes, ETH3D provides sub-millimeter accurate geometric ground truth, benchmarking both high-resolution multi-view stereo matching and continuous multi-camera visual-inertial SLAM under challenging lighting conditions.
